LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 9.3.1 WORD CLASSES: CONJUNCTIONS – BECAUSE, THAT, WHEN, IF, UNLES

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 9
Topic 9.3: Grammar in use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Conjunctions – because, that, when, if, unles

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Grammar in use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Conjunctions – because, that, when, if, unles
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why should we join sentences correctly?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify the listed conjunctions from a group of words
2. use the listed conjunctions correctly in sentences
3. appreciate the correct use of conjunctions in communication

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Grammar in use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Conjunctions – because, that, when, if, unles

• Listen to a model.
• Study the example.
• Then produce your own example.

▸ Grammar in use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Conjunctions – because, that, when, if, unles

Teach
• Focus skill: identify the listed conjunctions from a group of words.
• Use complete sentences.
• Speak clearly; write neatly.

Worked example
• Model sentence 1 about Grammar in use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Conjunctions – because, that, when, if, unles.
• Model sentence 2 using a Kenyan school example.
• Model dialogue: A: “…?”  B: “…”

Try this
• Write 5 original sentences on this skill.
• Say one 30-second oral example to a partner.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• One clear model for Grammar in use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Conjunctions – because, that, when, if, unles
• One Kenyan school/home example

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences.
2. Do one oral practice with a partner.
3. Correct spelling/punctuation.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet: meaning + 5 examples + 5 practice items.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why should we join sentences correctly?
2. Why do we use conjunctions?
3. How can one join two or more sentences?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Model first, then try.
• Use complete sentences.

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
